title: How Long Cover Has Been Away and the Rate the Reinstatement Fee Is Taken At
content:
How long a Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment has stood without cover, measured against the reinstatement window its plan publishes, settles the rate the plan's reinstatement fee is taken at.

- Where less than half the plan's reinstatement window has run since cover fell away and money stands owed to the host on the enrolment, the fee is taken at the marketplace's prompt-restoration rate of 80 percent.
- Where half that window or more has run since cover fell away, it is taken at the marketplace's late-restoration rate of 1.4 times the fee.
- Where less than half that window has run and no money stands owed to the host, the fee is taken in full.

### The window each plan publishes

| Plan | Reinstatement window, calendar days |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 30 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 30 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 45 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 60 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 90 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 120 |

Half of the window is half of that figure in calendar days: 15 days on the Keyturn Shield 90 and Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plans, 22.5 on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, 30 on the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan, 45 on the Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan and 60 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on a published fee of 125)

| Days since cover fell away, window of 60 | Money owed to the host | Fee taken at |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | some | 100.00 |
| 20 | none | 125.00 |
| 30 | either | 175.00 |
| 44 | either | 175.00 |

The middle rate governs from the moment half the window has run, whether or not money stands owed to the host.
